newsitem.title: USA: ComEd 789 MW Ill. nuke seen on line Thurs.
newsitem.headline: ComEd 789 MW Ill. nuke seen on line Thurs.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co's 789 megawatt Quad Cities nuclear power unit 2 was expected to resume electricity output Thursday afternoon after being taken off the grid for repairs, a company spokesman said.
"We expect to begin ramping up later this afternoon," spokesman Gary Wald said Thursday.
The unit was removed from the grid Thursday, although the unit's turbine remained at 20 percent power, while the company replaced a circuit board, Wald said.
Power output at the Cordova, Ill. unit was reduced Wednesday to about 35 percent of capacity ahead of the repairs.
Commonwealth Edison is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
